title: Tier 1 allowed to apply for virtual card
description: Verifies Tier 1 users can successfully apply for a virtual prepaid card, enforcing tier-based access as defined. Automation: HIGH — straightforward UI flow with clear, observable UI state changes.
testDescription: As a Tier 1 (Unverified) registered user, I can access the virtual card application flow and complete the application, resulting in a new virtual prepaid card visible in my account.
prerequisites: Platform reachable and stable, Test Tier 1 user account exists and is active with no existing virtual prepaid card, Browser session is clean (no cached auth), No maintenance windows blocking card operations
stepsToPerform: 1) Navigate to the EvolvePay login page and verify the page loads successfully. 2) Log in with Tier 1 user credentials (email: test+tier1vc@example.com, password: ********) and confirm landing on the dashboard/home. 3) Open Profile and verify verification status displays as Tier 1 (matches available statuses Tier 1, Tier 2, or Pending). 4) Navigate to Prepaid Card Management and open the Virtual Card application screen; verify the Apply/New Virtual Card action is visible and enabled for this Tier 1 user. 5) Click Apply/New Virtual Card to start the application and verify a confirmation/review screen or modal indicates Virtual prepaid card. 6) Confirm/Submit the application and observe a success indication (e.g., navigation back to cards view or success confirmation). 7) In the Cards/Account summary, verify a new card entry appears associated with the user and is identified as Virtual (e.g., type/label indicates virtual). 8) Open the new card’s details page and verify the details page loads and references this virtual card (no physical card-only elements are required). 9) Log out and verify session ends (return to login).
expectedResult: A) The Apply action for a virtual prepaid card is accessible to a Tier 1 user and submission succeeds without authorization errors. B) A new virtual prepaid card record is created and visible under the user’s cards, identifiable as Virtual. C) Tier-based access control is honored exactly as specified for virtual cards (Tier 1 allowed).

stateAfter: User has one new virtual prepaid card visible in account

title: Tier 2 allowed to apply for virtual card
description: Verifies Tier 2 (Verified) users can apply for a virtual prepaid card, ensuring parity of access across tiers. Automation: HIGH — UI assertions on access and post-creation visibility.
testDescription: As a Tier 2 (Verified) user, I can open the virtual card application flow, submit it, and see the newly created virtual prepaid card in my account.
prerequisites: Platform reachable and stable, Test Tier 2 user account exists (KYC completed) with no existing virtual prepaid card, Browser session is clean (no cached auth), No maintenance windows blocking card operations
stepsToPerform: 1) Navigate to the EvolvePay login page and verify it loads. 2) Log in with Tier 2 user credentials (email: test+tier2vc@example.com, password: ********) and confirm successful dashboard load. 3) Open Profile and verify verification status displays as Tier 2. 4) Go to Prepaid Card Management and open the Virtual Card application screen; verify the Apply/New Virtual Card action is visible and enabled for Tier 2. 5) Click Apply/New Virtual Card and verify an application confirmation/review step indicates Virtual prepaid card. 6) Confirm/Submit the application and observe a success indication. 7) In the Cards/Account summary, verify a new card appears and is identifiable as Virtual. 8) Open the new card’s details page and verify details load for this virtual card. 9) Log out and verify return to login.
expectedResult: A) The virtual card application is available to a Tier 2 user and the submission completes successfully. B) A virtual prepaid card record is created and visible, labeled/identified as Virtual. C) Tier-based access control parity is validated (Tier 2 allowed, consistent with Tier 1 allowance).

title: Tier 2 allowed to send international remittance
description: Confirms Tier 2 users can initiate and submit an international remittance per tier-based access rules. Automation: MEDIUM — UI flow plus history verification.
testDescription: As a Tier 2 (Verified) user with an existing beneficiary, I can access the Send Money flow, submit a transfer, and see the transfer recorded in remittance history.
prerequisites: Platform reachable and stable, Test Tier 2 user account exists (KYC completed), At least one saved beneficiary exists for this user (Full Name, Country, Bank Account/Mobile Money), User account has sufficient balance to submit a transfer, No maintenance windows blocking remittance operations
stepsToPerform: 1) Navigate to the EvolvePay login page and verify it loads. 2) Log in with Tier 2 user credentials (email: test+tier2remit@example.com, password: ********) and confirm dashboard loads. 3) Open Profile and verify verification status displays as Tier 2. 4) Navigate to International Remittance and open the Send Money flow; verify the action is accessible (no authorization/gating error). 5) Select an existing saved beneficiary from the list and verify their details are populated. 6) Enter a valid transfer amount (e.g., 100.00) and proceed; verify the flow advances to the confirmation step. 7) Submit/Confirm the transfer and observe a success indication (e.g., confirmation screen or banner). 8) Navigate to Remittance History and verify a new transfer entry appears corresponding to the submitted transfer. 9) Verify the entry displays a valid status as defined in the platform (e.g., Pending, Completed, or Failed) without authorization errors. 10) Log out and verify return to login.
expectedResult: A) Tier 2 user can access and submit the international remittance send flow without authorization errors. B) The submitted transfer is recorded and appears in Remittance History. C) The history entry shows a valid platform status (Pending, Completed, or Failed), confirming the transfer was accepted into the system.
